# Denwebs

> Denwebs is a Shopify agency that plans, builds, and runs the full commerce
> stack: strategy, design, development, catalogue/inventory/order operations,
> and AI (AEO, agentic commerce, automation), so brands sell more with a
> system that stays coherent.

## Services

- [Commerce consulting](https://www.denwebs.com/services/consulting): Strategy, platform evaluation, roadmaps, fractional counsel.
- [Shopify audits](https://www.denwebs.com/services/audits): UX/CRO, technical, integration, and AI visibility audits.
- [UX / UI design](https://www.denwebs.com/services/design): Design systems for Shopify, PDP/collection/cart.
- [Development](https://www.denwebs.com/services/development): Online Store 2.0 builds, custom sections, Functions, headless.
- [Migrations](https://www.denwebs.com/services/migrations): Replatforming from Magento, SFCC, BigCommerce, WooCommerce with SEO preservation.
- [Catalogue management](https://www.denwebs.com/services/catalogue): Product data models, enrichment, feed readiness.
- [Inventory](https://www.denwebs.com/services/inventory): Multi-location, ERP sync, allocation rules.
- [Order management](https://www.denwebs.com/services/order-management): OMS, routing, 3PL, returns, B2B flows.
- [Integrations](https://www.denwebs.com/services/integrations): ERP / PIM / 3PL, middleware and custom connectors.
- [CRO](https://www.denwebs.com/services/cro): Experimentation programs, landing pages, analytics.

## AI practice

- [AI for Shopify brands](https://www.denwebs.com/services/ai): Hub for AEO, agentic commerce, and ops AI.
- [AI Search Optimization (AEO / GEO)](https://www.denwebs.com/services/ai/aeo): Visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews.
- [Agentic commerce readiness](https://www.denwebs.com/services/ai/agentic-commerce): Machine-readable catalogues for AI shopping agents.
- [AI for store operations](https://www.denwebs.com/services/ai/operations): Supervised enrichment, forecasting assists, order triage.
